integrity: The source normalization and complete eigenvalue definition are stated explicitly. Numerical tests check finite examples only; large-T assertions rest on analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotics are pointwise in fixed delta away from delta=1; no explicit finite-T threshold, double scaling, unequal-width extension or independent specialist check. Historical equivalence to an older gamma-density/Poisson-mixture result cannot be excluded.
title: Two-ring Fock localization: a sharp modal transition and inward spectral bias
